text: (Approaches Jesus with a kiss) Here's the man you want, Romans.
Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?
Judas, how could you do this? We trusted you.
This is a dark day for us all. We must stay strong.
We must not let this act of betrayal break our spirits.
Lord, should we strike with our swords?
“No more of this!” (He heals the wounded and calms the crowd)
Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs? 53 Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.
